chunks: And Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام about the Jumu‘ah prayer during travel: what should I recite in them? He said:

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan, the Imam being asked
key_terms.أَقْرَأُ: I recite; what I should recite
key_terms.فِيهِمَا: in the two units / in both of them
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Surat al-Ikhlas, the chapter instructed for recitation here

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in the Jumu‘ah prayer while traveling according to Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding what is to be recited in the Jumu‘ah prayer while traveling. Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام directs the questioner to recite «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ», indicating its prescribed use in this prayer context.
